description: Daily historical prices for a US stock, ETF or index: date, open, high, low, close and volume, newest first, for any date range up to 10 years back (max 1,000 rows per call). Data from Nasdaq.com's public historical quotes API (Stooq blocks automated downloads). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
